composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-110a "24V DC SERVICE SUPPLY") documents the BAE-side generation of the vessel's +24V DC service bus from the two HVPDU 600V DC buses via PORT/STBD MAPS-1/2 converters, plus a standalone 230V AC-fed 24V/110A supply, and the fused distribution of that +24V bus to downstream loads: FWD/AFT DC panels, main bilge pump, fire pump, AUX service battery bank, and BAE start-key/service-mode control logic (Re1/Re2, PC CARD). It serves: 620-hvpdu (both 600V DC buses, Q1-4 breakers, F1/F2 500A fuses — dual PORT/STBD sides explicitly labelled), 626-maps-p and 626-maps-s (the two labelled MAPS-1/2 2x5KW converter boxes), 634-battery-aux-service (labelled AUX SERVICE BAT. 200Ah 24V with SW11/F16), 520-main-bilge-pump and 520-fire-pump (named loads off the +24V service bus fused terminals), 640-dc-distribution (FWD DC PANEL / AFT DC PANEL taps), 652-onyx-monitoring (multiple CT taps labelled 'to ONYX'), and 625-bae-system (BAE START KEY SW / Service Mode logic, BAE VOLTAGE SENCE cross-ref to DWG 413, Re1/Re2 relay logic). The +24V SERVICE BUS itself, SHUNT #1, isolator/contactor bank SW1-5/SO1-5, and PC CARD/negative bus are infrastructure of 640-dc-distribution.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: HV Power Distribution Unit (HVPDU, port + stbd)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Sheet explicitly labels 'PORT HVPDU' and 'STBD HVPDU' 600V DC buses with Q1-Q4 32A breakers and F1/F2 500A fuses feeding the MAPS converters — this matches the established HVPDU identity fact exactly (Q1-4 32A + F1/F2 500A per side).

functions.label: Port 600V DC bus distribution to MAPS converters and other BAE loads
functions.what_it_does: Distributes the PORT 600V DC bus, protected by four 32A breakers (Q1-Q4) and main fuses F1/F2 500A, to downstream 600V DC consumers including the PORT MAPS-1/2 converters.

flow_scenarios.path: PORT 600V DC bus -> Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 (32A each) -> individual 600V DC feeders -> PORT MAPS-1/2 converters (600V DC input)
PORT 600V DC bus -> F1 500A / F2 500A main fuses -> bus bar -> Q1-Q4 branch breakers

functions.dry_data: 600V DC bus; 4x Q 32A breakers; 2x F 500A fuses per side
functions.sheet_region: top-left (PORT HVPDU) and mid-left (STBD HVPDU), bbox ~[0,0.04,0.13,0.29] and [0,0.48,0.13,0.72]

functions.label: Stbd 600V DC bus distribution to MAPS converters
functions.what_it_does: Mirrors the port side: STBD 600V DC bus distributed via four Q1-Q4 32A breakers to the STBD MAPS-1/2 converters.

flow_scenarios.path: STBD 600V DC bus -> Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 (32A each) -> STBD MAPS-1/2 converters (600V DC input)

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Box explicitly labelled 'PORT MAPS-1/2 2x5KW', converting 600V DC to 24V DC, matching engineer mapping PORT MAPS-1/2 -> 626-maps-p.

functions.label: Convert port 600V DC to 24V DC for service bus
functions.what_it_does: Two 5kW modular converter units take 600V DC from the PORT HVPDU bus and step it down to 24V DC, feeding fused outputs (F1 250A, F2 250A) toward the CT-monitored feeders to the isolator/contactor bank and onward to the +24V service bus. Converters are electronically fused and over-current protected per sheet note.

flow_scenarios.path: PORT 600V DC bus -> PORT MAPS-1/2 converter (600V DC in) -> 24V DC out -> F1 250A / F2 250A fused feeders -> CT1/CT2 current transformers (monitoring, 'to ONYX') -> isolator bank SW1/SW2 -> SO1/SO2 contactors -> +24V service bus

functions.label: Buffer/back-up 24V supply on the service bus
functions.what_it_does: A 200Ah 24V battery bank connects to the +24V service bus (via SHUNT #1 500A/50mV current-measurement shunt) through switch SW11 and fuse F16 250A, providing buffered/backup capacity for the service bus.

functions.label: BAE start-key / service-mode control loop
functions.what_it_does: Provides the BAE start-key switch function in Service Mode: closes/opens via T/S S terminal strip contacts (terminals 5-9, 8-12) routed to Re1/Re2 relays, driven by four switch/relay lamp-indicator positions (switch1-4) fed from a common bus, with a cross-reference onward to 'Re 2a' on DWG 113.

+24V service bus tap -> BAE VOLTAGE SENCE line -> onward reference (see DWG 413)

infrastructure.system_name: DC Distribution Panels (+24V Service Bus, PC CARD, negative bus)
facts: +24V SERVICE BUS bar fed from SHUNT #1 (500A/50mV) after the isolator/contactor bank (SW1-5/SO1-5), distributing to F5 100A (SW6, FWD DC PANEL), F6 200A (SW7, AFT DC PANEL), F7 60A (SW8, BILGE PUMP), F8 60A (SW9, FIRE PUMP), F9 125A (SW10, feeds CT6 'to ONYX' / LV.BAE PANEL)
ISOLATORS bank SW1-SW5 with corresponding SO1-SO5 contactors sit between the MAPS/CT feeders and the +24V service bus, selecting/isolating each MAPS output onto the bus

PC CARD enclosure (numbered I/O terminals 1-10 both sides, BEL-1/4 230V AC CONTROL out to DWG 401a, BAE/AUX/NEG/+EM terminal strip, rotary BAE/AUX selector, 5-lamp indicator bank) is the local control/indicator card for the distribution panel, cross-ref 'to ON/OFF SW see DWG 114'
NEGATIVE BUS / 230V AC GROUND bar (=SHIPS GROUND) ties together FWD DC PANEL, AFT DC PANEL, BILGE PUMP, FIRE PUMP, GEN START BAT., EMERGENCY BAT., AUX SERVICE BAT. return paths
T/S E terminal (fused, terminals 8/8a) feeds QE7 6A breaker onward 'to +24V EMERGENCY POWER'
24V 110A / 230V AC supply (L/N in, F18 125A output fuse) is a standalone 230VAC-derived 24VDC source feeding into this distribution/control logic, separate from the MAPS/HVPDU 600V DC path
